title: Denpa Shounen-teki Game
overview:
A super-powered project teaming up Nippon TV's "Susume! Denpa Shounen" with Hudson!

Akiko Matsumoto also takes part as narrator!!

A party game loosely based on the TV variety show, packed with ten minigames for up to seven players. Whack the characters that pop up, win at rock-paper-scissors and strike first, spot subtle differences between pictures, play a round of "Daruma-san ga Koronda," race to be first to the top of a climb, follow the red flag, white flag calls and guess what you just saw. Lose, and a penalty game awaits.

- 1-7 players
- Multi Terminal 6 compatible
- Ryo Fukawa, known from the show's "Invincible Salesman" segment, appears

This is the not-for-sale TV event version of the game.

日本テレビ「進め！電波少年」と、ハドソンがタッグを組んだ超強力企画！

松本明子もナレーションで参加！！
